products.subtitle: Nivis Labs Korean Moon Light Night Cream is a deeply nourishing overnight treatment formulated to repair and restore skin health while you sleep. Powered by advanced ingredients like Lotus PDRN, Cica Exosomes, Ceramide, Sodium Hyaluronate, Shea Butter, and Niacinamide, this rich cream provides deep hydration, strengthens the skin barrier, and improves skin elasticity. Wake up to smooth, radiant, and intensely hydrated skin every morning.
